children: The dollar's fortunes are now closely tied with the AI trade, Ebury's Matthew Ryan says in a note. Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia chief executive calmed fears over the rout in tech stocks, he says. Since much of the world's AI exposure sits in U.S.-listed companies, "every swing in appetite for the theme is taking the dollar along for the ride." When AI stocks rally, so does the dollar, he says. "Yet with so much now riding on the fortunes of only a handful of stocks, markets are likely to remain jumpy, and yesterday's reversal on the return of just one man is a case in point." The DXY dollar index falls 0.1% to 104.189 after hitting a 20-month high of 104.530 Monday. (renae.dyer@wsj.com)
